name: lawcheck
description: Write an architecture rule down once, and stop watching for it in every change your coding agent makes. Lawcheck checks while the agent writes, before it finishes, and in CI. The plugin sends your agent back, up to three times, while the files of its turn break those rules. It gives the agent the law of the repository at the start of every session, checks the file of each edit it makes with Write, Edit or NotebookEdit, and checks every file of the turn before the agent finishes. The hooks run Lawcheck and the repository's rule scripts, so use it where you would run the repository's tests. Its skill, /lawcheck:setup, writes the first law of a repository from its code and asks you before it forbids a use that the code already makes.

check_after_edit.title: Check each edited file
check_after_edit.description: After the agent writes or edits a file in a repository with a law, run lawcheck check on that file and show the agent what breaks the law.

check_before_stop.title: Check before the agent finishes
check_before_stop.description: When a turn that changed files is about to end, run lawcheck check on them and send the agent back while they break the law.
